name: @tkl/credential-vault
description: Tenant/product/source-scoped connector credential storage: sanitized connection metadata plus encrypted-at-rest credentials.

scripts.build: node --check src/index.js && node --experimental-strip-types --check src/store.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --check src/crypto.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --check src/persistent-store.ts && npm run verify-entry
scripts.typecheck: node --check src/index.js && node --experimental-strip-types --check src/store.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --check src/crypto.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --check src/persistent-store.ts
scripts.lint: node --check src/index.js && node --experimental-strip-types --check src/store.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --check src/crypto.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --check src/persistent-store.ts
scripts.verify-entry: node --experimental-strip-types -e "import('@tkl/credential-vault').then((m)=>{ if (typeof m.InMemoryCredentialVault!=='function'||typeof m.createPersistentCredentialVault!=='function') { console.error('package entry point is missing expected exports'); process.exit(1); } console.log('credential-vault package entry point import verified'); }, (error)=>{ console.error(error); process.exit(1); })"
